# Giant Ape (`monsters:giant-ape`)
*Huge beast, unaligned* | **CR** 7 (XP 2,900; PB +3)
**AC** 12 | **HP** 168 (16d12 + 64) | **Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
**STR** 23 (+6) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 18 (+4) | **INT** 5 (-3) | **WIS** 12 (+1) | **CHA** 7 (-2)
**Skills:** [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md) +9, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +4, [Skill: Survival](../proficiencies/skill-survival.md) +4
**Senses:** Passive Perception 14
**Languages:** None

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The ape makes two Fist attacks.
- **Fist.** Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
- **Boulder Toss (Recharge 6+ (1d6)).** The ape hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

## Bonus Actions
- **Leap.** The ape jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
